about: Printed size of the text inside figures of 3363 published journal articles from 132 journals, measured with figfit.paper_figures on 2026-11-21. Sizes are in points as printed on the journal page. Each paper is one value, the median of its figure labels. 35 % of papers store their figure text and give exact sizes (method text); the rest have figures saved as images and were read by OCR from up to four figures each (method ocr), with the OCR sizes divided by 1.041, the amount OCR read too large on 2051 figures of known size. median_pt is the median of the paper medians; paper_medians_p25_p75 and paper_medians_p10_p90 are ranges of the paper medians; p10_pt and p90_pt are percentiles of all labels pooled, at most 200 from one paper. small_text uses papers with stored text only. Journals with 10 or more measured papers have their own entry.
